10.t: Working with data: a coordination test
q: Calculate the improvement for each hand.
Suggest why the left hand improved more (for right-handed students).
It had more room to improve: its pathways were less practised, so practice made a bigger difference.
Explain, using the nervous system, why practice speeds up the task.
Repeating the task strengthens the pathways (synapses) in the brain and the cerebellum gets better at coordinating the muscles, so fewer errors and faster movements.
